assessment.diversity_evidence: All 20 stories share the same locked-door, missing-key problem, lantern-assisted search under a bench, unlocking, and stepping through. Names and small wording differences do not change the plot; s000057, s000039, s000035, s000024, and s000038 add only an initial failure to see the key. The sample shows little meaningful variation, without establishing diversity across the whole generator.
